_HOWTO: Copy to profiles/<model>.json and fill in. Then: ppd.py probe --profile <model>.
Every field below is read by code; a wrong regex or signpost template is the usual
cause of an empty level. Fill what you can, probe, and fix what it reports MISSING -
a model with only the e2e block is still worth a level-0 pass.
v1 is validated on Gemma4 only, so expect to discover fields this template lacks.
model: <short id, used in the run directory name>
branch_expected: <branch these numbers were taken on, or null>
env_file: <a shell file sourced before every device run, or null>

<type-b>.note: context-invariant  <- start this note with 'context-invariant' to mark the A8 control

floor_fit_chunks: <the 2-3 chunk sizes the floor is fitted over; omit for the smallest three>

e2e._: the whole-model chunked-prefill test. Levels 0-3 all rest on per_chunk_re.
e2e.per_chunk_re: <regex with named groups i, n, start, end, ms - one match per chunk>
e2e.summary_re: <regex with device_s / staging_s / readback_s, or null>

layer_bench._: the isolated-layer benchmark. Without it, levels 1-2 are unavailable.
layer_bench.result_re: <regex with named groups lt, idx, kv, ms>
layer_bench.fake_depth_field: <the valid-KV-length field the test sets, e.g. kv_actual_global>

layer_count_override._: how to truncate the model to N layers for layer-count differencing.
layer_count_override.how: <env var or flag, if there is one>
layer_count_override.reason: <if unavailable, WHY - this becomes the degradation message>

growing_op._: the op expected to grow with context. occupancy is what the Cores column hides (A3).
growing_op.name: <exact OP Code substring as tt-perf-report prints it>
growing_op.source: <path to the program factory, so the work-unit math can be re-read>

ablation_catalogue.scope_note: <what this knob does NOT vary - A1 scope discipline>

ablation_sites_note: Level 3 is assisted only: propose, get approval, verify the revert.

artifacts._: existing logs/captures, so levels can run offline before any device time.

validation._: published numbers this profile must reproduce. Omit the block if there are none;
validation.__: with it, `ppd.py validate` becomes a real regression test for the whole skill.
